(3) A hand picks up a bag of scones from a shelf. The scene shifts to the woman in a kitchen setting, holding a collection of five food items including a box, a jar, and bags of snacks. (4) Close-up of a boxed cheesecake labeled 'Premium Cheesecake'. A spoon picks up a creamy slice, showing a textured crumb base. The woman eats a bite and gives a thumbs-up. (5) Close-up of small black plastic cups of sesame pudding. A spoon lifts a thick greyish-black paste. The woman eats it and shows an appreciative expression. (6) Close-up of a glass jar of strawberry jam. A spoon scoops out large, whole red strawberries. The woman eats a strawberry and smiles. (7) A green bag of matcha cookies is shown. A cookie is broken in half to reveal its vibrant green interior. The woman holds a cookie and speaks to the camera. (8) A black bag of truffle-flavored potato chips is displayed. The woman holds the bag, eats a thin, crispy chip, and reacts with surprise and delight. (9) A rapid montage follows, showing various store sections including sauces, desserts, marinated eggs, donuts, and gua bao. The woman is seen from behind reaching for a jar on a high shelf. (10) A man and a young child walk through a shopping mall. Finally, the woman is seen holding the child in a more intimate, soft-lit setting.
